title: Full-Stack Web Development Bootcamp
description: Master modern web development from HTML5/CSS3 to React 19, Node.js, REST APIs, and Cloud Database persistence.
overview: This comprehensive course takes you from zero programming experience to a job-ready full-stack web developer. You will build production-grade web applications, master modern JavaScript frameworks, and create clean database integrations.
learningOutcomes: Build dynamic, responsive web interfaces with HTML5, Tailwind CSS, and React 19
Write modular JavaScript ES6+ code with Async/Await, Fetch API, and Promises
Develop RESTful APIs using Node.js, Express, and middleware
Implement Database persistence using MongoDB and PostgreSQL
Deploy scalable web apps to Vercel, Netlify, and Cloud Servers

topics.title: Semantic HTML5 & Web Accessibility (a11y)
topics.summary: Learn how semantic markup improves search engine indexing, accessibility, and modern codebase structure.
cheatSheet: Use <main> once per document for primary content.
Always include alt attributes on tags.
Use <button> for actions and <a> for navigation links.

topics.title: Modern CSS Grid & Flexbox Layouts
topics.summary: Design responsive multi-column layouts with CSS Grid and dynamic alignable components with Flexbox.
cheatSheet: Flexbox: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
Use gap instead of margin hacks for spacing grid children.

topics.title: Async/Await, Promises & Fetch API
topics.summary: Master non-blocking asynchronous JavaScript execution, promise chains, and REST API integration.
cheatSheet: Always wrap await calls inside try...catch blocks.
Use Promise.all() for independent parallel API requests.
Check response.ok when using standard fetch().

topics.title: React 19 Hooks, State & Component Architecture
topics.summary: Master useState, useEffect, custom hooks, and component lifecycle management in modern React.
cheatSheet: Never update state directly; always use the setter function.
Include all variables referenced inside useEffect in its dependency array.
Return cleanup functions from useEffect to clear timers or listeners.

modules.title: Module 3: Backend REST APIs & MongoDB Persistence

topics.title: RESTful API Architecture with Node.js & Express
topics.summary: Build scalable Express HTTP servers with JSON middleware, routing, and controller architectures.
cheatSheet: Use app.use(express.json()) to parse JSON body payloads.
Map HTTP verbs cleanly: GET (read), POST (create), PUT/PATCH (update), DELETE (remove).
Always send proper HTTP status codes (200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 404 Not Found, 500 Error).

topics.title: MongoDB Schema Design & Mongoose ODM
topics.summary: Model MongoDB document collections using Mongoose schemas, indexes, and document queries.
cheatSheet: Define unique indexes for fields like email or courseId to prevent duplicates.
Use Mongoose .populate() to handle relational references between collections.
Use async/await with Mongoose query promises.
